title: Hopper FP8 enablement: stability sweep and ensemble selector for E4M3/E5M2
creator: Ariel Chen
description: Enable FP8 quantization profiles (E4M3/E5M2) for Hopper inference fleet with a stability-focused rollout. Deliver an ensemble selector that picks per-model and per-shard activation variants, plus a full calibration + validation pipeline and canary plan.
background: Multiple teams have validated FP8 in isolated offline runs. Recent regressions observed on long-context chat and code models attributable to per-layer activation clipping and shard warming. Current approach lacks a lightweight runtime selector that can route to E4M3 vs E5M2 based on live stability signals.
scope: Build selector service (heuristic + ensemble fallback), expand calibration harness to include synthetic noise and long-context golden prompts, add telemetry gates and SLO-based canary traffic ramp, produce runbook and rollback automation. Exclude INT8 work for this ticket (handled separately).
success_metrics: 1) No P99 latency regressions >5% vs int baseline during canary. 2) Accuracy drift <=1.5% on golden prompt suite. 3) Canaries auto-fail <1% false positive rate. 4) FP8 enabled for 25% of eligible traffic in two weeks after canary.
acceptance_criteria: Selector service running behind feature flag and able to serve decisions within 2ms median overhead
Calibration pipeline produces activation maps and per-layer scale factors for both E4M3 and E5M2 for top-50 models
Golden-suite accuracy regression <=1.5% for canary batch and <=2% for staged rollout
Telemetry gating: create dashboards for per-route token error rate, per-layer clipping rate, and model-quality diff; alerts configured
Automated rollback trigger triggers if model-quality diff over 2% for 3 consecutive 5m windows
tasks: Implement lightweight ensemble selector: heuristic layer-sensitivity + voting model that supports hysteresis
Extend calibration harness with synthetic noise injection and end-to-end token-perplexity metric
Add per-op clipping telemetry and percentile histograms to runtime telemetry pipeline
Create golden prompt suite (500 samples across chat, code, summarization) and baseline metrics
Run full sweep across representative top-50 models to collect E4M3/E5M2 profiles
Deploy 2-node canary pool on dedicated Hopper machines and throttle traffic to 1% -> 5% -> 25
Integrate selector decisions into smart routing layer with feature flag and shadow mode
Write runbook: canary dashboard interpretation, rollback steps, and mitigation scripts
Open PRs and request design/PM review; add security checklist for KMS interactions
rollout_plan: Start in shadow mode for 48h on canary pool (0% traffic) to validate selector stability, then progressive traffic ramp: 1% traffic (24h) -> 5% (48h) -> 25% (7 days). At each step validate golden-suite and telemetry gates before progressing. Use feature flagging for immediate cutoff.
rollback_plan: Automatic rollback if model-quality diff > 2% for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR if latency P99 > baseline+10% for 15m. Manual rollback steps documented in runbook: disable feature flag, scale down canary nodes, switch routing to fallback model-variant, open incident with SRE.
validation_results: Initial stability sweep (synthetic + golden-suite) on five representative models shows mean token-perplexity delta 0.7% for E4M3 and 0.9% for E5M2 vs fp16 baseline; two long-context outliers flagged for per-layer clipping tuning. Will re-run after per-op clipping thresholds adjusted.
notes: Decided to prioritize a lightweight selector rather than an expensive model-based predictor to keep runtime overhead minimal on latency sensitive routes. We'll evaluate a small ML predictor in a follow-up ticket if heuristics hit an accuracy ceiling.
